title.zh: 一点点二氧化碳 · 地球为什么会变暖
title.en: A Little CO₂ · Why the Planet Warms

desc.zh: 空气里每一万个分子只有四个多是二氧化碳，它怎么能让整个地球变暖？七个可以拖动的模型：能量收支、一层毯子、越高越冷、“已经饱和”、反馈、敏感度区间和海洋的拖延。只讲物理，不做预测。
desc.en: Only about four in every ten thousand air molecules are CO₂, so how can it warm a whole planet? Seven models you can push: the energy budget, one blanket layer, emitting from higher up, "already saturated", feedbacks, the sensitivity range and the ocean's lag. Physics only, no projections.

title.zh: 行星能量平衡与有效温度
title.en: Planetary energy balance and effective temperature

desc.zh: 吸收的阳光 S(1−α)/4 要等于放出的红外 σT⁴；没有大气的地球会停在约 255 K，比观测的 288 K 冷 33 K。
desc.en: Absorbed sunlight S(1−α)/4 must equal emitted infrared σT⁴; an airless Earth would settle near 255 K, 33 K colder than the observed 288 K.

en: how cold would Earth be without air

title.zh: 温室效应：一层只挡红外的大气

desc.zh: 空气层让阳光通过、吸收地面红外并向下退回一半，地面要放出更多热才能平衡；吸收比例 0.76 时地面正好 288 K。
desc.en: A layer that passes sunlight but absorbs ground infrared sends half back down, so the ground must run warmer; absorbing 76 % gives exactly 288 K.

zh: 为什么有大气地球更暖
en: why does an atmosphere warm the surface

title.zh: 排放高度：越高越冷，从高处散热
title.en: Emission height: cooler air higher up radiates to space

desc.zh: 地球向太空散热的地方在高空，高空总是那个约 255 K；加厚大气把排放层抬高，下面就要更暖。
desc.en: Earth sheds heat from high in the air, which always sits near 255 K; a thicker atmosphere lifts that level, and everything below must warm.

zh: 加二氧化碳为什么变暖
en: why is it colder higher up
why does more CO2 warm the surface

desc.zh: 15 微米吸收带的中心早已不透明，但两侧的坡随浓度变黑，所以每翻一倍挡住的红外差不多一样多：约 3.7–4.7 W/m²。
desc.en: The centre of the 15 µm band is long opaque, but its sloping wings keep darkening, so every doubling blocks about the same amount: roughly 3.7–4.7 W/m².

zh: 二氧化碳不是已经饱和了吗

title.en: Climate feedbacks: one degree becomes three

desc.zh: 加倍二氧化碳本身只带来约 1.2 K；水汽、冰雪和云把升温一轮一轮放大，合起来到约 3.4 K。
desc.en: Doubling CO₂ alone gives about 1.2 K; water vapour, ice and clouds amplify it round by round to about 3.4 K.

title.zh: 为什么敏感度的区间这么宽
title.en: Why the climate sensitivity range is so wide

desc.zh: 敏感度 = 无反馈升温 ÷ (1 − f)。f 的不确定是对称的，除出来的敏感度却拖着一条长长的高尾巴。
desc.en: Sensitivity = no-feedback warming ÷ (1 − f). A symmetric uncertainty in f becomes a long high tail in sensitivity.

zh: 为什么预测范围这么大
en: why is the range so wide

title.zh: 海洋的拖延与时间常数
title.en: Ocean lag and the time constant

desc.zh: 海洋像一锅需要慢慢烧开的水：二氧化碳加倍那年只走完一部分升温，剩下的要几十到几百年，取决于参与的水有多深。
desc.en: The ocean is a slow pot to heat: when CO₂ has doubled only part of the warming has arrived, and the rest takes decades to centuries depending on how deep the mixed water goes.

zh: 为什么停止排放还会变暖
